title.es: Cómo Anthropic construye software en 2026 con Katelyn Lesse
title.en: How Anthropic builds software in 2026 with Katelyn Lesse

body.es: Anthropic reescribió su API de Python a Rust en unos cinco meses, sin expertos en Rust en el equipo ni revisiones de código estrictas, apoyándose en Claude para aprender el lenguaje. La empresa utiliza un agente de revisión de código que decide si los cambios mecánicos requieren revisión humana, permitiendo que Claude gestione y despliegue correcciones de pruebas inestables. Este enfoque reduce la fricción en el ciclo de desarrollo, aunque depende de la capacidad del modelo para validar cambios de bajo riesgo.
body.en: Anthropic rewrote its API from Python to Rust in about five months, without Rust experts on the team or strict code reviews, relying on Claude to help engineers learn the language. The company uses a code review agent that decides if mechanical changes need human review, allowing Claude to handle and deploy fixes for flaky tests. This approach reduces friction in the development cycle, though it relies on the model's ability to validate low-risk changes.

evidence.claim: Anthropic rewrote its API from Python to Rust in around five months.
The rewrite was done without Rust experts on the team or strict code reviews.
Anthropic has its own code review agent running at all times.
Engineers at Anthropic spend a lot more time building tooling than before.
Knowing a programming language well is starting to not matter.

title.es: OpenCode publica la versión 2.4.2 con mejoras en automatizaciones
title.en: OpenCode releases v2.4.2 with automation improvements

body.es: La versión 2.4.2 de OpenCode permite a las automatizaciones continuar ejecutándose tras un fallo, registrando el error y programando la siguiente ejecución. También introduce la tecla Esc para recuperar el último mensaje del compositor si la respuesta se detiene antes de que el modelo genere contenido. Estas mejoras aumentan la resiliencia de los flujos de trabajo de agentes y facilitan la edición de comandos fallidos.
body.en: OpenCode v2.4.2 allows automations to continue running after a failure, logging the error and scheduling the next run. It also introduces the Esc key to retrieve the last composer message if a response is stopped before the model generates content. These improvements increase the resilience of agent workflows and make it easier to edit failed commands.

evidence.claim: v2.4.2 is an immutable release with only the title and notes modifiable.
GPT-6.2 system prompt is used for GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra, and their aliases.
Esc key can be used to take back the last message in the composer.
Automations continue to run even after a failed run, but still pause when the session or directory is gone.
Moving a session also moves its subagents.

title.es: Brecha de seguridad en 1Password: qué se accedió y qué no
title.en: 1Password Security Breach: What Was Accessed and What Wasn't

body.es: 1Password confirmó una brecha de seguridad que permitió a un atacante acceder a nombres, correos electrónicos y metadatos de cuentas de un subconjunto de usuarios, pero no a los contenidos de las bóvedas. La cuenta de GitHub comprometida se usó para acceder al código fuente y empujar código malicioso a los servicios de backend. La empresa ha rotado las credenciales internas y ampliado los códigos de recuperación de seis a diez dígitos alfanuméricos para dificultar los intentos de adivinación.
body.en: 1Password confirmed a security breach that allowed an attacker to access names, email addresses, and account metadata for a subset of users, but not vault contents. The compromised GitHub account was used to access source code and push malicious code to backend services. The company has rotated internal credentials and expanded recovery codes from six to ten alphanumeric digits to hinder guessing attempts.

evidence.claim: 1Password experienced a security breach earlier this month.
Some customer names and email addresses were accessed during the breach.
The breached GitHub account was used to access source code and push malicious code to backend services.
Customer vaults and the items in them were not accessed during the breach.
There is no impact to 1Password's services, availability, or product security.

title.es: Un MacBook Air rediseñado con OLED podría lanzarse en 2027 o 2028
title.en: Redesigned OLED MacBook Air Could Launch in 2027 or 2028

body.es: Según Mark Gurman de Bloomberg, Apple planea actualizar el MacBook Air con chips M6 a principios de 2027, pero sin un nuevo diseño. Una renovación más extensa, que podría incluir una pantalla OLED, está prevista para finales de 2027 o 2028. Dado que el MacBook Air es el ordenador más popular de Apple, esta actualización busca mantener el producto fresco tras la última rediseño en 2022.
body.en: According to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, Apple plans to refresh the MacBook Air with M6 chips in early 2027, but without a new design. A more extensive overhaul, which could include an OLED display, is expected for late 2027 or 2028. Given that the MacBook Air is Apple's most popular computer, this update aims to keep the product fresh following the last redesign in 2022.

evidence.claim: A MacBook Air with a new look could launch in late 2027 or 2028.
Apple plans to refresh the MacBook Air with M6 chips in early 2027.
A more extensive overhaul could follow later in 2027 or in 2028, and the MacBook Air could get an OLED display at that time.
Apple last overhauled the MacBook Air's design in 2022.
The MacBook Air is Apple's most popular computer, and they need to keep it very fresh.

body.es: Cloudflare ha lanzado Search for Agents, un servicio que crea automáticamente una instancia de búsqueda de IA e indexa el contenido de un sitio web para hacerlo accesible a agentes. La función está disponible para todos los clientes, incluido el plan gratuito, y anuncia el punto de acceso de búsqueda en cada página. Soporta el nuevo método HTTP QUERY para consultas de búsqueda en texto plano o JSON.
body.en: Cloudflare has launched Search for Agents, a service that automatically creates an AI search instance and indexes a website's content to make it accessible to agents. The feature is available to all customers, including the Free plan, and advertises the search endpoint on every page. It supports the new HTTP QUERY method for search queries in plain text or JSON.

evidence.claim: Search for Agents automatically creates an AI Search instance and starts indexing content.
Search for Agents is available to all Cloudflare customers, including the Free plan.
Search for Agents automatically advertises the search endpoint on every page of the site.
Search for Agents supports the new HTTP QUERY method for search queries.

title.es: Apple lanzará dos productos nuevos la semana que viene
title.en: Apple to Launch Two New Products Next Week

body.es: Apple prepara el lanzamiento de un HomePod mini 2 con malla exterior roja y unos AirPods Max 2 en color plata con almohadillas blancas y Digital Crown roja para el 1 de diciembre. La fecha coincide con el Día Mundial del Sida y el 20.º aniversario de la organización RED, lo que sugiere que los productos llevarán la etiqueta (PRODUCT)RED. Parte del precio de cada unidad se destinará al Fondo Mundial para luchar contra el sida.
body.en: Apple is preparing to launch a HomePod mini 2 with a red exterior mesh and silver AirPods Max 2 with white earpads and a red Digital Crown on December 1. The date coincides with World AIDS Day and the 20th anniversary of the RED organization, suggesting the products will carry the (PRODUCT)RED label. Part of the price of each unit will go to the Global Fund to fight AIDS.

evidence.claim: Apple is set to launch two new products on December 1st.
The HomePod mini 2 will have a red exterior.
The AirPods Max 2 will be silver with white earpads and a red Digital Crown.
The launch date of the new products coincides with the World AIDS Day and the 20th anniversary of (PRODUCT)RED.
The new products are expected to be launched to support the (PRODUCT)RED campaign.

title.es: La guerra de precios de Black Friday baja el Mac Studio M5 Max a 2.299 dólares
title.en: Black Friday Mac Studio price war drives M5 Max desktop down to $2,299

body.es: El Mac Studio con chip M5 Max ha bajado a 2.299 dólares en Black Friday, con descuentos de hasta 300 dólares en configuraciones mejoradas por parte de minoristas rivales. Expercom iguala el descuento, llevando el precio al nivel de la oferta educativa de Apple sin requisitos de elegibilidad. El equipo incluye un CPU de 18 núcleos, GPU de 32 núcleos, 36 GB de memoria unificada y un SSD de 512 GB.
body.en: The M5 Max Mac Studio has dropped to $2,299 on Black Friday, with discounts of up to $300 on upgraded configurations from rival retailers. Expercom is matching the discount, bringing the price down to Apple's education pricing without eligibility requirements. The desktop features an 18-core CPU, 32-core GPU, 36GB of unified memory, and a 512GB SSD.

evidence.claim: The M5 Max Mac Studio is priced at $2,299 on Black Friday.
Expercom is matching the discount, bringing the desktop down to Apple's education pricing.
The M5 Max Mac Studio features an 18-core CPU, 32-core GPU, 36GB of unified memory, and a 512GB SSD.
The M5 Max Mac Studio earned five stars in our hands-on review for its professional performance and value.

También soporta habilidades globales en proyectos remotos y mejora el rendimiento de la terminal.
text.en: Zed Agent v1.31.0-pre adds thread-only choices for models, profiles, and thinking effort, as well as an Ultrafast response speed option for supported OpenAI and ChatGPT models. It also supports global skills in remote projects and improves terminal rendering performance.

evidence.claim: v1.31.0-pre is a pre-release version.
Thread-only choices have been added for agent models, profiles, and thinking effort.
An Ultrafast response speed option has been added for supported OpenAI and ChatGPT Subscription models.
Global agent skills can now be supported in remote projects.
Performance improvements have been made to the app layout and terminal rendering.

text.es: Anthropic ha introducido una función que permite a los usuarios convertir artefactos de Claude en aplicaciones de escritorio, que pueden crearse, ejecutarse y compartirse. Esta capacidad amplía el uso de Claude más allá del chat, permitiendo la creación de herramientas interactivas locales.
text.en: Anthropic has introduced a feature allowing users to turn Claude artifacts into desktop apps, which can be created, run, and shared. This capability expands Claude's use beyond chat, enabling the creation of local interactive tools.

title.es: La función Familiar Faces de Google ahora funciona en la cámara de 35 dólares de Walmart

text.en: A Google Home update brings Familiar Faces support to Walmart's $35 Onn Outdoor Camera and $77 Onn Floodlight Camera. A Google Home Premium subscription is still required to access the feature. Additionally, Gemini Live is getting an upgrade to its speech-to-speech architecture for faster response times.

Google Home update brings Familiar Faces support to the $35 Onn Outdoor Camera Plug-In and $77 Onn Floodlight Camera Hardwired.
A Google Home Premium subscription is still required to access the Familiar Faces feature.

title.es: La facturación de la revisión de código de Copilot pasará a la organización
title.en: Copilot code review billing will default to the organization

text.es: A partir del 30 de diciembre de 2026, las revisiones de código de Copilot se facturarán a la organización por defecto. Este cambio afecta a las organizaciones que utilizan la función y requiere una revisión de las políticas de facturación actuales.
text.en: Starting December 30, 2026, Copilot code review billing will default to the organization. This change affects organizations using the feature and requires a review of current billing policies.

evidence.claim: Copilot code review billing will default to the organization starting December 30, 2026.

developer_signals.author: thsottiaux
developer_signals.original_text:
We made a billing mistake at launch of GPT-6.2 that incorrectly discounted GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol usage for most users. 

We’ve fixed this now, so the same work will use more of your plan’s usage allowance. Comparing to last week, you will reach your limits 40% faster on GPT-6.2 Astra and 25% faster on Sol. You should still see these go further in usage compared to 6 Astra and 6.1 Sol. Other models weren’t affected, and we won’t charge you for the difference on past usage.

As a small token to apologize for the mistake, we’ll be adding one banked reset for everyone on Go, Plus, Pro, and Business.

text.es: Thibault Sottiaux de OpenAI admite un error de facturación en el lanzamiento de GPT-6.2 que descontaba incorrectamente el uso de Astra y Sol. El uso alcanzará los límites un 40% más rápido en Astra y un 25% más rápido en Sol, aunque se mantendrá por debajo de las versiones anteriores. OpenAI ofrecerá un reinicio bancario a todos los usuarios de Go, Plus, Pro y Business como disculpa.
text.en: OpenAI's Thibault Sottiaux admits a billing mistake at the launch of GPT-6.2 that incorrectly discounted Astra and Sol usage. Usage will reach limits 40% faster on Astra and 25% faster on Sol, though it will still go further than previous versions. OpenAI will offer a banked reset to all Go, Plus, Pro, and Business users as an apology.

developer_signals.author: rauchg
developer_signals.original_text:
As AI gets smarter, implementation details blur away: permissions, code diffs, commands, tool calls…

The harness itself blurs away. It's a high-performance vehicle for code and command execution, and a durable storage engine.

All of fx still fits in 6mb: subagents, MCP, skills, sessions, durability, ACP, TUI, network transport…

text.es: Guillermo Rauch de Vercel señala que a medida que la IA se vuelve más inteligente, los detalles de implementación como permisos y llamadas a herramientas se difuminan. El 'harness' se convierte en un vehículo de alto rendimiento para la ejecución de código y un motor de almacenamiento duradero, con toda la funcionalidad de fx cabiendo en 6 MB.
text.en: Vercel's Guillermo Rauch notes that as AI gets smarter, implementation details like permissions and tool calls blur away. The 'harness' becomes a high-performance vehicle for code execution and a durable storage engine, with all of fx's functionality fitting in 6MB.

developer_signals.author: karpathy
developer_signals.original_text:
I asked Claude to populate a Civilization-style game map with real data from the US. Opus 5.5 downloaded and parse a ton of public data and 7 hours and 45K lines of code later... it works :)

- 31 real data sources including Census, BEA, BLS, EIA, NOAA, USGS, DoD, NPS, FAA, FEMA, CDC...
- Real elevation, land cover, GDP, jobs, power plants, mines, ports, airports, bases, parks, universities, freight flows, disasters; all reconciled onto one 25 km hex grid.
- The data is converted into Civilization language, e.g. Gold yield is GDP. A city's districts are its real industry specializations: San Jose gets a Campus, Detroit is "Motor city". Its citizens are its real workforce: 1 in 4 San Jose workers are engineers, coders or scientists, against 1 in 14 nationally. Wonders are chosen by published rules, such as national parks by visitor numbers and universities by R&D spending, etc etc.
- 19 lenses (income, degrees, faith, disasters…), a City View for 524 metros, and nine advisors plus an Explorer. The Explorer turns any column for any of 3,100+ counties into a table and scatter plot, linked to the map.
- Claude decided to skip a few states and territories sry
- Built using Claude Code desktop app, Opus 5.5 on medium and turning on ultracode.

It's deployed here: https://t.co/QMhmafXMj5 and the "?" has the source link too. I don't exactly know where I was going with this but it's really fun to browse and play with. Possibly it can be expanded or built into a game. I only have half of my weekly Claude quote left though so someone else will have to take over :D. Claude also made a trailer:

text.es: Andrej Karpathy comparte un proyecto donde Claude Opus 5.5 descargó y analizó datos públicos de EE. UU. para poblar un mapa de juego estilo Civilization. El resultado incluye 31 fuentes de datos reales, 45.000 líneas de código y 19 lentes de visualización, demostrando la capacidad de los agentes para integrar datos complejos en aplicaciones interactivas.
text.en: Andrej Karpathy shares a project where Claude Opus 5.5 downloaded and parsed US public data to populate a Civilization-style game map. The result includes 31 real data sources, 45,000 lines of code, and 19 visualization lenses, demonstrating agents' ability to integrate complex data into interactive applications.

developer_signals.author: HamelHusain
developer_signals.original_text:
Looking at the decision index benchmarks and wow pervasive overfitting of models!!! 

I'm more likely to use a model that has a high & consistent public + private score vs. those with a huge drift

Also, beware - the models are sorted by public scores in the individual benchmark cards

https://t.co/iZYaTRaiD9

text.es: Hamel Husain analiza los benchmarks de decisión y señala un sobreajuste generalizado en los modelos. Prefiere usar modelos con puntuaciones públicas y privadas altas y consistentes frente a aquellos con una gran deriva, advirtiendo sobre la importancia de la generalización en la evaluación de modelos.
text.en: Hamel Husain analyzes decision benchmarks and points out pervasive overfitting in models. He prefers using models with high and consistent public and private scores over those with huge drift, warning about the importance of generalization in model evaluation.

developer_signals.author: rauchg
developer_signals.original_text:

For harness durability (@eve, libfx, pi, opencode…), this is a big deal, as it crushes latency in between turns.

Upgrade to 𝚠𝚘𝚛𝚔𝚏𝚕𝚘𝚠@𝚕𝚊𝚝𝚎𝚜𝚝. No code changes. https://t.co/GmvGi7Ryh9

text.es: Guillermo Rauch anuncia que Vercel ha vuelto a hacer los workflows 10 veces más rápidos, reduciendo la latencia entre pasos y acelerando los turnos de agentes duraderos. Esta mejora es crucial para la durabilidad de los harnesses de agentes, ya que elimina la latencia entre turnos sin requerir cambios de código.
text.en: Guillermo Rauch announces that Vercel has made workflows 10x faster again, reducing step-to-step latency and speeding up durable agent turns. This improvement is crucial for agent harness durability, as it crushes latency between turns without requiring code changes.

text.es: Steve Ruiz comparte una prueba formal en Lean de una propiedad geométrica de rectángulos redondeados, demostrando que el radio exterior R debe ser r + d si un rectángulo redondeado con radio r está dentro de otro con un huego uniforme d. El proyecto ilustra el uso de asistentes de prueba para validar propiedades de diseño.
text.en: Steve Ruiz shares a formal Lean proof of a geometric property of rounded rectangles, demonstrating that the outer radius R must be r + d if a rounded rectangle with radius r sits inside another with a uniform gap d. The project illustrates the use of proof assistants to validate design properties.
